commands.name: CreateNetworkElementModel
steps: normalize name/manufacturer and show same-description candidates outside lock
inside UoW insert single receipt before children, allocate immutable model id, insert active model and created event
audit/commit
rules: descriptive equality never silently reuses/merges model identity

commands.name: UpdateNetworkElementModel
steps: normalize/show candidates
inside UoW require exact active model/revision
insert receipt, update descriptive fields/revision and append descriptive-corrected event
audit/commit
commands.rule: existing Network Element model assignments retain same model identity

commands.name: ChangeNetworkElementModelLifecycle
steps: inside UoW archive blocks new assignments/compatibility but preserves current/historical assignments and compatibility history; reactivate restores selector eligibility
insert receipt/update lifecycle/event/audit/commit
rules: archival does not rewrite installed components or assigned Network Elements

commands.name: SetNetworkElementModel
steps: inside UoW require Network Element active and selected Model active when non-null
insert receipt before relationship event
append assign/change/clear event and replace/remove current assignment
audit prior/new relation and commit
rules: no free-text competing model authority is created
changing Model does not rewrite Installed Component history or compatibility rows

commands.name: ChangeModelBomCompatibility
steps: normalize BOM/role and show existing exact compatibility candidates
inside UoW require Model active for add/correct and exact relation state
insert receipt and append immutable compatibility event; insert/update/remove rebuildable current relation as action requires
audit/commit
rules: compatibility means reusable allowed/reference knowledge only
no Installed Component instance is created/changed

commands.name: RegisterInstalledComponent
input: optional Task id + Inventory physical-consequence id/fingerprint for maintenance origin
steps: normalize bounded descriptors and show same-BOM/serial/slot candidates without identity inference
for maintenance_consequence preview minimized LLD-07 InventoryPhysicalConsequence and require represented install relation fits target Network Element/Device Reference context
inside UoW require Network Element active; when maintenance-derived call InventoryPhysicalConsequenceReader.validate_current and fail on STALE/INVALID/INDETERMINATE
validate known slot is not occupied by another current installed component
insert receipt; allocate installed_component_id; insert identity and registered/installed event as represented; build current projection
audit component/consequence refs and commit
rules: different physical replacement gets different installed_component_id
manual/legacy observation may exist without Task/consequence if independently known
Model compatibility does not establish instance identity

commands.name: RecordInstalledComponentLifecycle
input: optional Task/consequence evidence for maintenance-derived physical change
steps: outside lock preview current component/slot and optional Inventory evidence
inside UoW reload exact component and Network Element; maintenance-derived install/remove must revalidate current LLD-07 physical consequence/fingerprint
validate slot occupancy when resulting state=installed with known slot
insert receipt; append exact lifecycle/correction event and rebuild projection
audit prior/new current-effective facts and commit
rules: correction targets prior event; a later genuine replacement/removal is a forward event, not correction

commands.name: ResolveDevicePartToInstalledComponent
steps: outside lock preview Device Part Unit, Device Reference resolution and Installed Component Network Element
inside UoW call DevicePartInstalledComponentResolution.validate_target; require VALID for link/correct
insert receipt before resolution event; append link/correct/clear event and replace/remove current row
audit both immutable identities and commit
rules: relationship never merges identities or transfers lifecycle ownership
unresolved Device Part Unit remains valid
one current Device Part Unit per Installed Component and vice versa
